title: REALTY EXECUTIVES Sets Record with Top 3 Highest-Priced Luxury Home Sales in Nutley, NJ
text:
Nutley, NJ - March 5, 2025 - REALTY EXECUTIVES has achieved a significant milestone in the Nutley real estate market by successfully selling the top three highest-priced luxury homes in the area. These sales underscore the growing demand for high-end properties just 13 miles from New York City, particularly among NYC commuters seeking suburban luxury living.
According to the Garden State MLS, these record-breaking transactions highlight Nutley’s evolving real estate landscape and its appeal to discerning buyers. The town’s proximity to Manhattan, coupled with its blend of historic charm and modern amenities, has made it a prime location for luxury homebuyers.
Matthew DeFede, a leading real estate broker with REALTY EXECUTIVES, played a key role in these high-profile sales. “Nutley has become a sought-after destination for buyers looking for space, privacy, and easy access to New York City,” said DeFede. “The recent surge in demand for luxury properties in this area reflects a larger trend of professionals and families relocating from urban centers to well-connected suburban communities.”
Luxury Homes in High Demand
Nutley’s luxury real estate market has seen a steady rise in interest from buyers who value its convenient location and sophisticated housing options. The recent high-value transactions are indicative of this growing trend, positioning the town as an emerging hotspot for high-end real estate in northern New Jersey.
As the real estate market evolves, REALTY EXECUTIVES remains committed to providing expert guidance to buyers and sellers navigating this competitive landscape. The firm continues to leverage its deep market knowledge, innovative marketing strategies, and extensive network to connect clients with the finest properties available.
About REALTY EXECUTIVES
REALTY EXECUTIVES is a premier real estate firm specializing in luxury homes, with a strong presence in Nutley, NJ, and surrounding areas. The company is dedicated to delivering exceptional service, market expertise, and tailored real estate solutions to clients looking to buy or sell high-end properties.
For more information on buying or selling luxury homes in Nutley, NJ, visit Matthew DeFede’s website.
